Headline: #36 Broadway Temporary Southbound Reroute near LaSalle Metra Station
ShortDescription: Southbound 36 Broadway buses are temporarily rerouted via Clark, Harrison, Dearborn and over regular route, due to street blockage near LaSalle Metra Station.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Southbound #36 Broadway buses are temporarily rerouted via Clark, Harrison, Dearborn and over regular route, due to street blockage near LaSalle Metra Station.

Northbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
